$comment: Hidden achievements (the panel's Achievements tab). Every entry shows as '???' until unlocked; only the count and the vague `hint` (a category, never the how) are visible before that. `title` and `description` are revealed once it is unlocked. `goal` is the count needed by counting ones (cursor wins, Geo, wall jumps); 'every ...' ones count against what the pet actually has (visitors, regions, bench styles, enemy kinds). The ids are wired to their criteria in skong-core's `achievements` module: an id it doesn't know never unlocks, and removing an entry disables it. Original writing only, never text from the game.

achievements.title: Silken Small Talk
achievements.description: Spoke with Hornet, and she spoke back. Mostly.

achievements.title: Dreams of Glass
achievements.description: Dream-nailed a window and overheard what it was thinking.

achievements.title: Uninvited, Inside
achievements.description: Dream-nailed a visitor and read their quiet thoughts.

achievements.title: Soul Spent
achievements.description: Gathered his soul and let a spell fly.

achievements.title: Bounce, Don't Land
achievements.description: Struck downward in mid-air and sprang off the blow.

achievements.title: The Floor Is Lava
achievements.description: Felled a Vengefly without once setting foot on the desktop floor, from the first blow to the last.

achievements.title: What Goes Down
achievements.description: Fell to his death, then hunted down his Shade and won it all back.

achievements.title: Unscheduled Departure
achievements.description: The window he stood on went for a walk without him.

achievements.title: Bested by an Arrow
achievements.description: Lost a duel to the cursor. It happens to the best of bugs.

achievements.title: Pointer Collector
achievements.description: Won five duels against the cursor.

achievements.title: Off the Wall
achievements.description: Charged a crystal dash while clinging to a wall, and launched.

achievements.title: Shortcut Through Sleep
achievements.description: Planted a Dream Gate where his feet couldn't go, and stepped through.

achievements.title: Rockhound
achievements.description: Mined a Geo rock in every region your apps hide.

achievements.title: Connoisseur of Seats
achievements.description: Rested on every kind of bench your windows hide.

achievements.title: Full Guestbook
achievements.description: Talked with every visitor who ever drops by.

achievements.title: Diligent Student
achievements.description: Saw a nailsage's lesson through to the final bow.

achievements.title: Humbled the Mighty
achievements.description: Took up Zote's challenge, and won the spar.

achievements.title: Ran the Gauntlet
achievements.description: Survived a gauntlet from the first foe to the last.

achievements.title: Slow and Serene
achievements.description: Caught him in his slug form, crawling without a care in the world.

achievements.title: Literate Bug
achievements.description: Highlighted some text, and caught his curiosity.

achievements.title: Glass into Geo
achievements.description: Closed a window, and it shattered into Geo.

achievements.title: Hoarder
achievements.description: Picked up a thousand Geo, one coin at a time.

achievements.title: A Heavy Purse
achievements.description: Picked up five thousand Geo. Hallownest's shopkeepers would weep.

achievements.title: Do Not Disturb
achievements.description: Poked him while he napped.

achievements.title: Bug Toss
achievements.description: Picked him up and threw him.

achievements.title: Nice Catch
achievements.description: Caught him again before he could land from a throw.

achievements.title: Behind the Lines
achievements.description: Watched him step behind a line drawn on screen instead of through it.

achievements.title: Up the Shaft
achievements.description: Five wall jumps in a row without touching down.

achievements.title: Long Way Down
achievements.description: Fell so far that the landing shook him to the shell.

achievements.title: Field Guide
achievements.description: Beat one of every kind of enemy that wanders in.

achievements.title: Final Curtain
achievements.description: Answered a scarlet flame, met the master of its troupe, and won the show.

achievements.title: Taken a Bow
achievements.description: Fell to the Troupe Master. He bowed, very politely, and left a Shade behind.

achievements.title: Comparing Notes
achievements.description: Sat beside Cornifer, maps open, while he hummed and corrected them both.

achievements.title: Room for Two
achievements.description: Shared a high ledge with Quirrel and simply took in the view.

achievements.title: Work Song
achievements.description: Stayed by Myla at the rock face until her mining song was done.

achievements.title: Faster Than Silk
achievements.description: Beat Hornet to her own needle. She will want a rematch.

achievements.title: Needle Practice
achievements.description: Crossed nails with Hornet and saw the duel through. She won. She always wins.

achievements.title: A Passing Troupe
achievements.description: The Troupe Master dropped by just to bow, and was gone in a flicker of red.

achievements.title: Interior Decorator
achievements.description: Picked up five different things around him and set them down somewhere better.

achievements.title: Splinters
achievements.description: Practised on a training dummy until it gave up and came apart under his nail.
